title: lupinus leucophyllus subsp. erectus
intro:
Lupinus leucophyllus subsp. erectus, commonly known as the Bigberry lupine, is a perennial plant species in the legume family, known for its unique characteristics and medicinal properties.

This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Lupinus leucophyllus subsp. erectus are believed to be attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and potential antidiabetic agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily isoflavones and other alkaloids, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
